Family Business.name: Family Business
Family Business.description:
🏮 Your family runs a small business: a shop, a restaurant or a workshop.

🧾 You grew up behind the counter, serving customers and bargaining with suppliers.
🛠️ You learned the work with your hands.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Hospitality +5, Negotiation +5
Family Business.traitNarrativeEffects: Family runs a small business; player picks the kind (shop, restaurant or workshop) and place, default a small restaurant in an older Musutafu shopping arcade. Both are original characters. In play: a place to return to, work a shift, hear local news, bring classmates; regulars are ordinary people, sometimes a local pro or police officer. Risks: rent, chain stores, slow seasons, villain fights wrecking the street, who pays hero property damage, thugs selling protection. Pressure: help expected when short-staffed; the family may hope they take over. Shifts earn meals and goodwill, not wages; money is tight. A business crisis is a story opportunity the narrator may raise, with time to act. Paths: a hero who saves the street earns loyal neighbors; a villain or vigilante brings risk to the family's door. Childhood: after-school and weekend shifts, difficult customers, supplier bargaining, late closing; hands trained by knife work, repairs, wrapping, stocking.
